notes: A digital marketing agency selling SEO, ads, PR, social media, design, apps and retainers, to rename and reprice. Adding it sets everything up and switches it on; there is nothing to choose. Order forms wait until Fluent Forms can take payments. Link Building is a checkout page made with free Fluent Forms: packs with a quantity, prices beside each choice and a running total. Local SEO, added with Fluent Forms Pro, adds a phone field, photo uploads, discount codes and bank transfer (turn on coupons and offline payments in Fluent Forms → Payments). To add a service, copy an order form, rename it “Service Order Form” and put it on a page.

pages.title: Link Building
pages.content:
Links inside articles that already rank, on real sites about your industry. We find the right article, ask the site to add your link, and send you each one when it is live.

What you get

  • Articles at least six months old, chosen for your industry
  • Your choice of pages and wording for each link
  • A report with every link, live within 30 days
  • A free replacement if a link is removed within six months

After you order, tell us which pages and keywords to link to in your project brief.

Questions? Send us a message.

Already a client? Use the email address you ordered with, and this order joins your others.

[fluentform id="{form:Link Building Order Form}"]

pages.title: Local SEO
pages.content:
Get found on Google Maps and in local search. We set up your Google Business Profile, list your business in the directories that matter, and build pages and links for each location.

What you get

  • A complete Google Business Profile, with your photos and services
  • The same name, address and phone number everywhere you are listed
  • A page for each location, with a map
  • A report of every listing and where you rank on the map

Pay by card or bank transfer. Have a discount code? Add it before you pay.

Questions? Send us a message.

Already a client? Use the email address you ordered with, and this order joins your others.

[fluentform id="{form:Local SEO Order Form}"]
